why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Read the Hashcats docs and check the live numbers on the homepage first: the entry price, the epoch and when the last cat was mined.
Set up a wallet on Robinhood Chain with enough ETH for the entry price and gas.
Open the Mine page and connect the wallet. A solution you find works only for your own address.
Choose CPU or GPU mining, check the cost of the next cat and start.

When your browser finds a hash, confirm the transaction, which sends the entry price. The docs say a solution "dies with the next cat, or in about 25 seconds", so a mint can fail through no fault of yours.
costs: The entry price was 0.16368 ETH on 8 October 2026, and gas on Robinhood Chain adds very little. The early cats cost a small fraction of that. You also spend electricity and time on the mining itself, with no guarantee of finding a hash before someone else does.
risks: We found no audit. The main collection contract has no verified source code on the public verification services we checked. A single ordinary account owns the collection, the token and the hook, and the staking contracts were upgraded once already, on 18 September 2026.
